title: Safety Tier Table
description: Per plan 015 (Action Layer): maps a ruleId (or, as a fallback, a subSkill) to one of finding.schema.json's remediation safety tiers. See plans/015-action-layer-recommendations-autofix.md and CONTEXT.md §10.1.

_note.description: Free-text provenance/rationale note, same convention as knowledge/*.json's own _note fields — not schema-validated content, just documentation.

subSkillDefaults.description: Fallback tier per subSkill, used when a ruleId has no entry in ruleOverrides — needed for sub-skills (e.g. code-review) whose ruleIds are generated dynamically, not from a fixed, enumerable catalog.

ruleOverrides.description: Explicit tier per ruleId — takes precedence over subSkillDefaults whenever present.
